metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for generating 3D models using Hyper3D Rodin Gen-2 API

plugins.name: rodin3d-skill
plugins.description: Converts input images or prompt to 3D models using Hyper3D Rodin Gen-2 API. Use this skill when users want to generate 3D models from images or text, such as product designs, architectural elements, or object reconstructions.
